summary: Iteration 7 tested username rules, recovery email, forgot/reset password (real Emergent email send to delivered@resend.dev, 202 Accepted), GRI and non-overlapping TIR bands, and the AI recap closed state staying saved after reload. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (run with -n 0). Frontend: every requested flow passed at 375x667: register hint and errors, email prompt save/skip with warning, Settings email row warning/add/change sheet, Stats GRI card (UI 31 = 3*5.7+2.4*3.2+0.8*7.3 = 30.6), Low and High rows hidden with target 50/260 (labels 'In range (54–250)'), recap collapsed after reload and reopen saved, and the full forgot -> code -> new password -> signed in flow. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Edge case: settings allow target_low up to 399 and target_high down to 41. If target_low > 250 (e.g. 260/300), bands = {low:260, high:250}, so low (54<=v<260) and very_high (>250) both count 251-259. Same if target_high < 54 (high and very_low overlap). Clamp lo to <=250 and hi to >=54, or reject such targets in PUT /settings.
Duplicate route: server.py:93-95 declares a second @auth_api.get('/me') returning {id, username}. It is shadowed by the auth.py one registered at line 87, so it is dead code. Remove it.
The attempts check (>=5) and the $inc are not atomic, so parallel guesses can go past 5 attempts. Also no TTL index on password_resets.expires_at, so expired docs are never removed.
Existing 60-day JWTs stay valid after a password reset or change (no token version or iat check). Consider invalidating old sessions.

issues: The recap state key 'recap-card-state' is shared by all accounts on the device, not per user. The card also shows open for a moment before AsyncStorage loads (state starts true).

action_items: Clamp TIR bands so lo <= hi always (lo = min(max(target_low,54),250), hi = max(min(target_high,250),54)), or restrict target_low/target_high in PUT /settings
Remove the dead duplicate GET /api/auth/me handler in server.py:93-95
Optional: make the reset attempts check atomic (find_one_and_update with attempts<5), add a TTL index on password_resets.expires_at, and invalidate old JWTs after a password reset

Optional: key the recap state per user and start it unknown to avoid the brief open flash; keep needsEmail across restarts (it is in memory only, so killing the app right after sign-up skips the prompt)
critical_code_review_comments: The GRI formula is correct: 3.0*hypo + 1.6*hyper, with hypo = %<54 + 0.8*%54-69 and hyper = %>250 + 0.5*%181-250. Capped at 100; zones A-E at 20-point steps
Forgot gives the same message for unknown users and users without an email, so it doesn't reveal which accounts exist. The 60 s cooldown returns 429 (case-insensitive username)
The email template passes the safety checks; send_email maps provider errors to 503/502
settings.tsx (782 lines) and server.py (838 lines) are over 700 lines; consider splitting
seed_data_creation: TEST_r*/TEST_n* users (pytest) and TEST_fe392322/TEST_fe938570 (UI) were created and then deleted by id/username, along with their readings, settings and reset docs. demo_user was not changed. resettest1 was not used for the reset (password unchanged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the iter7 tests serially: pytest tests/test_iter7_reset_gri.py -n 0 (xdist breaks the shared module user and the test order). The browser automation env has no pymongo/bcrypt. For a UI reset test, patch db.password_resets.code_hash from a setsid/nohup background loop during the run (plain & jobs are killed when the bash call ends). Sheets animate in, so wait about 2 s or use dispatch_event('click') on sheet buttons.
